title: Moratorium on new takeaway liquor licences (Northern Territory)
summary: From 27 October 2017 the Director-General had to take into account a government policy that no new takeaway liquor licences be issued for two years.

instruments.title: Liquor Amendment (General Policy Direction) Regulations 2017
instruments.provisions: Liquor Regulations Part 5, reg 14: moratorium policy direction

commenced.what: Moratorium policy direction commenced on notification in the Gazette

direction_rationale: A bar on new takeaway licences blocks entry into liquor retailing, protecting incumbent licensees.
comparison: Other states and territories; licence counts before and after
notes: Later extensions under the Liquor Act 2019 not checked.
